notes.title: Snestle Patch
notes.notes:
Snestle Changes:[list]
[*]Reduced main attack bullet speed.
[*]Reduced Egg health from 250 -> 200.
[*]Mirror status effect bullet damage reduced from a range of 4-5 to 1-2.
[/list]

Other Changes:[list]
[*]Added a warning for going down a floor without getting the relic first.
[/list]

notes.title: Hot Fix Patch #1
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
Fixed an invincibility bug that triggered when certain status effects killed the player.

Not included but coming soon:
Changes to the Snestle boss to make it slightly easier. Possibly a reduction in health or movement speed.

notes.title: Penimorta Released Now!
notes.notes:
0Dark&Nerdy is proud to announce Penimorta, our bullet-hell top-down indie game with a unique pixel art graphic style.

In the game, you are a Wizard, convicted of Murder. You have been imprisoned in Penimorta, a tower twenty floors tall. Can you escape?

Penimorta consists of 10 bosses, over 20 unique enemies/prisoners, and a wide variety of powerful items. By the end of Penimorta, the player will feel incredibly powerful, regardless of which items they get. Good luck playing and watch the trailer below!
